prompt.zh-TW: 阿凱考慮入股初陽貿易，手上有完整的三張報表和一整頁指標，但只有十分鐘。他問你：先看哪一組指標？三個選擇都說得通，重點是你最擔心什麼。
prompt.en: Kai is considering buying into First Light Trading. He has the three statements and a full page of ratios, but only ten minutes. He asks you which pair of ratios to look at first. All three choices can make sense; what matters is what you are most worried about.

text.zh-TW: 先看 ROE 與負債比率
text.en: Start with ROE and the debt ratio

upside.zh-TW: 一眼看出股東的錢賺回多少，再用負債比率判斷這個報酬有多少是靠借錢撐出來的。
upside.en: Shows at once how much the shareholders’ money earns, and the debt ratio tells how much of that return is propped up by borrowing.

downside.zh-TW: 看不到短期的現金夠不夠付帳；一家 ROE 漂亮的公司也可能下個月付不出薪水。
downside.en: Says nothing about whether short-term cash can cover the bills; a company with a handsome ROE can still miss next month’s payroll.

text.zh-TW: 先看流動比率與現金流量比率
text.en: Start with the current ratio and the cash flow ratio

upside.zh-TW: 先確認公司活得下去：一年內的債有沒有資產和現金可以對付。入股之後最怕的是公司週轉不靈。
upside.en: Confirms first that the company can survive: whether the debts due within a year are matched by assets and cash. The worst outcome after investing is a liquidity crunch.

downside.zh-TW: 活得下去不等於值得投資；這兩個指標說不出公司賺不賺錢、報酬好不好。
downside.en: Surviving is not the same as being worth investing in; these two ratios say nothing about whether the company earns a good return.

text.zh-TW: 先看純益率與存貨週轉率
text.en: Start with the net profit margin and inventory turnover

upside.zh-TW: 直接看生意本身：每一元營收留下多少、貨賣得快不快，最貼近貿易公司的日常經營。
upside.en: Looks straight at the business itself: how much of each dollar of revenue is kept and how fast the goods sell, the closest to a trading company’s daily operations.

downside.zh-TW: 看不到資金結構與還債能力；生意好但借太多的公司，一次利率上升就可能出事。
downside.en: Says nothing about the funding structure or debt capacity; a good business that has borrowed too much can be undone by a single rise in interest rates.

viewpoint.zh-TW: 沒有一組指標能單獨回答「值不值得入股」。網站的看法是：最擔心公司撐不過明年，就先看流動比率與現金流量比率；公司體質穩定、想知道報酬，就先看 ROE 與負債比率；想了解生意本身，就先看純益率與存貨週轉率。不論先看哪一組，每個指標都要找第二個指標交叉檢查，例如 ROE 高要配負債比率、流動比率高要配速動比率、純益率升要配毛利率。十分鐘不夠看完，但夠你決定下一個小時要追問什麼。
viewpoint.en: No single pair of ratios can answer ‘is this worth investing in’. The site’s view: if your biggest worry is whether the company will survive next year, start with the current ratio and the cash flow ratio; if the company looks sound and you want to know the return, start with ROE and the debt ratio; if you want to understand the business itself, start with the net profit margin and inventory turnover. Whichever pair you start with, find a second ratio to cross-check each one, for example ROE against the debt ratio, the current ratio against the quick ratio, a rising net margin against the gross margin. Ten minutes is not enough to finish, but it is enough to decide what to ask in the next hour.

explanation.zh-TW: 這一題沒有標準答案；送出之後會看到三個做法各自的理由。
explanation.en: There is no single right answer here; once you submit, you will see the reasoning behind all three choices.
